whatsappMessage:
Hi Team RM Dance & Fitness Studio,

I noticed your studio has an incredible 5.0★ rating in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new class inquiries and batch timings.

Maine aapke studio ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, dance/fitness programs, aur batch schedules integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://rm-dance-fitness-studio.demo-preview.com

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team RM Dance & Fitness Studio, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and batch schedule highlights for your Kankarbagh location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact classes, actual studio photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
